_comment: Editable marketing content for pages/dental-implants-vietnam (implant.vietnamdentaltravel.com). fromPrice is a display-ready string (currency + thousands separator) injected verbatim - no runtime formatting; the numeric form for the JSON-LD drift guard is derived from it. ratingValue/ratingCount are VietnamDentalTravel's OWN Google aggregateRating and are deliberately kept separate from myvivatour's TripAdvisor facts (data/tripadvisor-reviews.json / shared.json).
